vector_set: Canonical NDC v2 Profile 1 — byte-derived ordering key
note: Record bytes are arbitrary abstract canonical JSON text. No external observation and no signing material is included.

cases.rule: Parse canonical record bytes, extract ordering fields, validate against the artifact profile, derive the key, sort, then emit the same validated bytes.
A key that does not recompute from the canonical record bytes is rejected on both sides; caller-supplied positions are not trusted.
The verifier independently repeats parse, extract, validate, derive and check on the received canonical bytes.
The declared order must equal the order induced by keys derived from the record bytes.

cases.condition: ordering fields are extracted from a re-serialized line that differs from the received canonical bytes
cases.rule: The canonical bytes are the sole input to key derivation; a re-serialized variant is a different byte sequence.

cases.payload_condition: the two records with the same derived key carry differing abstract payload values
cases.rule: Duplicate keys with conflicting payloads are rejected.
